name: Fine Print
tagline: The compliance software that reads the regulations so you don't have to.
positioning: Fine Print keeps dispensaries and grows audit-ready with automated METRC reconciliation, license tracking, and paperwork that actually files itself.

hero.h1: Stay open. The regulators are not your friends.
hero.sub: Fine Print syncs your METRC tags, flags reconciliation gaps before the state does, and turns license renewals into a two-click chore. Compliance without the panic attack.

features.title: METRC that reconciles itself
features.description: We pull your seed-to-sale data every night, match tags against inventory, and surface the discrepancies that trigger audits — before an inspector ever does.

features.title: License renewals on autopilot
features.description: Every state, county, and local permit tracked in one calendar. We nag you 90 days out so your license never lapses on a Friday afternoon.

features.title: Audit binder, pre-assembled
features.description: When the state shows up unannounced, export a complete, timestamped compliance packet in under a minute. No frantic printing.

features.title: Manifest checks that catch typos
features.description: Transport manifests validated against weight, package tags, and destination rules so a fat-fingered gram doesn't cost you a suspension.

features.title: Rules that update when the law does
features.description: Regulations change quarterly and nobody tells you. We track the bulletins and update your checklists automatically.

features.title: Real humans who speak regulator
features.description: Former compliance officers on chat, not a bot regurgitating the FAQ. Ask them the dumb question you're afraid to ask the state.

testimonials.quote: We failed a state audit in 2022 over a 4-gram variance nobody could explain. With Fine Print the variance report lands in my inbox at 6am. I've stopped losing sleep over METRC.
testimonials.name: Dana Reyes

testimonials.quote: I run two storefronts and a cultivation license across three jurisdictions. Fine Print is the only reason I haven't hired a full-time compliance manager I can't afford.
testimonials.name: Marcus Thibodeaux

testimonials.quote: The renewal reminders alone paid for the subscription. We nearly let our cultivation permit expire during harvest. Never again.
testimonials.name: Priya Anand

homepage.footerBlurb: Fine Print is compliance software for cannabis operators who'd rather run a business than read regulatory bulletins. Not legal advice, but close enough.
